in_hebrew.name: Christy
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Follower of Christ
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Christy הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'Christos', meaning 'anointed one'. In Christian tradition, the name Christy symbolizes a devotion to Jesus Christ.

in_greek.name: Christy
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Follower of Christ
in_greek.long_meaning: Christy είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Greek word 'Christos', meaning 'anointed one'. In Christian tradition, the name Christy symbolizes a devotion to Jesus Christ.

in_latin.name: Christy
in_latin.meaning: Name derived from Christian or Christ-like meaning
in_latin.long_meaning: Christy, nomen derivatum a Christiano vel Christico significato. In nomine Christiano, Christi significatio est. Nomen Christy, in lingua Latina, significat 'qui a Christo' aut 'qui similis est Christo'. Nomen hoc, a nominibus Christi et Ioannis, derivatum, in Ecclesia prima usum habuit.
